description: This file defines the internal class OverloadDetector, which determines whether the process is overloaded based on environment statistics and load shedding options. It includes methods for checking overload status and forcing a refresh.

classes.name: OverloadDetector
classes.description: Class responsible for detecting overload conditions in the Orleans runtime based on environment statistics and load shedding options.

methods.name: OverloadDetector
methods.description: Constructor initializing the overload detector with environment statistics provider and load shedding options.

methods.name: Enabled
methods.description: Property indicating whether overload detection is enabled.

methods.name: IsOverloaded
methods.description: Property that returns true if the process is currently overloaded, false otherwise.

methods.name: ForceRefresh
methods.description: Internal method to reset overload status, primarily for testing purposes.
